dispatchContract.ref: Use the retained ops branch/commit containing these reviewed scripts; record actual github.sha separately from application release.

requiredWorkflowInputs.confirmation: Use one exact selected-job confirmation below.
requiredWorkflowInputs.production_approval_reference: Retained final GO reference; required by workflow schema, unused by these selected verification jobs.
requiredWorkflowInputs.production_foundation_run_id: Actual final-SHA foundation ID; globally required, unused by these selected verification jobs.
requiredWorkflowInputs.production_migration_rehearsal_run_id: Actual final-SHA rehearsal ID; globally required, unused by these selected verification jobs.

dispatchContract.excludedActions: Do not select CONFIGURE/UPGRADE/BOOTSTRAP/legacy or VERIFY_V4_BROWSER_TEST jobs for final browser proof.
dispatchContract.workflowConcurrency: All operation dispatches share nxttrack-production-migration-recovery; host snapshots additionally lock each target. Browser job has no per-environment deployment lock: start only after both deployments finish.

browser.runner: ubuntu-latest; matrix staging/production; Chromium only; default matrix fail-fast. VERIFY_V4_STAGING selects staging only and is insufficient for final two-target proof.
require: Both selected matrix jobs completed successfully, neither skipped nor cancelled; each artifact exists.
Each verification.json has status=passed, target matches artifact, releaseSha equals applicationReleaseSha, verifierSourceSha equals actual ops workflow head SHA, and valid startedAt/finishedAt.
Every named check has status=pass and no error is present.
Exact-source database-aware health before AND after browser verification: HTTP200, ok=true, correct env/SHA, database and schemaCompatibility pass.
Public /, /login, /wachtwoord-vergeten and admin-origin /login render HTTP200 with h1; login email/password fields and enabled Inloggen; anonymous /platform redirects to /login.

Platform pages /platform, /platform/onboarding, /platform/themes, /platform/themes/import, /platform/themes/bindings, /platform/instellingen, /platform/packages, /platform/audit, /platform/support render with no error surface.
Tenantportfolio heading/search and, when tenantCount=0, correct empty state; onboarding first-next-back navigation plus loaded themes library.
platform temporary session revoked and password unchanged AND tenant inventory unchanged checks are mandatory.

Staging admin 4 routes, instructor 2 routes, parent 5 routes, /kind and /kind/reis; loaded nonempty rich artwork; camera settled; child-to-admin isolation; admin/instructor/parent cleanup/password checks all pass.
accountAndDataBehavior: Existing active platform_owner is selected from DB, never created; staging roles selected from existing aquaswim-demo memberships and optional exact email filters.
generateLink(type=magiclink) generates a token; verifyOtp authenticates it directly. No email delivery call, invitation, password-reset, password update or tenant-provisioning action is called.
Wizard Next/Previous are type=button state navigation; verifier never reaches or clicks final provisioning submit. Tenant count is compared before/after.
Auth session creation and staging child-mode/session context changes are intentional; this browser verifier is not entirely read-only.

Each successfully authenticated task has finally cleanup: browser context closes, client.auth.signOut({scope:local}) revokes only its own temporary session, then existing encrypted_password is compared in memory via boolean assert.ok. Other sessions are not globally signed out.
limitations: Magiclink session proves existing identity/authorization; login form visibility does not prove password-entry authentication.
Tenant-count equality is inventory-count evidence, not a full database-content equality proof.
Production checks platform administration only; tenant roles/child flow run only on staging. No production tenant, invitation or upload is created.
No inbox delivery, payment processing, full CRUD, exhaustive browser console/network audit, responsive capture matrix or mobile engine claim from this script.

verifyOtp occurs before task cleanup try/finally; authentication failure is not positive cleanup evidence. Cleanup/final-output errors may leave an incomplete/missing artifact: require completed successful jobs and explicit cleanup checks.
No explicit browser-job timeout; individual navigation waits are bounded, but database connect/query defaults are not independently bounded by this script.

Local signOut success proves the cleanup API call for that session; it is not a fresh auth.sessions absence query or immediate invalidation proof for already issued access JWTs, which can remain valid until expiry.
privacy: Password hashes are never put in result/assertion diffs; token/cookies/server key remain in memory; no storageState, HAR or tracing export.
verification.json currently records raw error.message on failure; inspect failure text before quoting/sharing it. Do not dump raw database/Supabase responses, cookies, links or auth hashes.
Screenshots can contain existing account or tenant display information. Keep GitHub artifacts private and review images before public sharing.

healthObservation.entrypoint: node scripts/release/observe-v4-health.mjs; local async exec session, not a workflow dispatch

env.OBSERVATION_OUTPUT_DIR: Choose a fresh dedicated local path and retain it with release evidence; default artifacts/v4-observation/{UTC-with-colons-replaced}-{sha7}-{pid}
env.OBSERVATION_TIMEOUT_MS: Optional, default15000; integer1000..20000; no command-line arguments

require: Start only after both targets run the final SHA; 31 combined samples, each containing both targets, from T0 through T30.
summary releaseSha equals final SHA; status=passed, complete=true, completedSamples=expectedSamples=31, elapsedMs>=1800000, failedSampleCount=0, failedSamples=[], interruptedBy=null, fatalError=null.
Every sample has status=passed, failures=[], indices0..30 and both distinct targets; each target HTTP200, checks.ok/environment/release-sha/database/schema-compatibility=true.
UTC timestamps and monotone elapsedMs/dueMs are present; samples more than30000ms late fail and remain counted even if later requests succeed.
Process exits0 only after complete successful observation; preserve all prior failures in JSONL and summary.
privacyAndLimits: Only fixed unauthenticated GETs; no cookies/secrets/alerts/mutations. Redirects rejected, response limit64KiB, request timeout bounded.
Only boolean checks, validated SHA, timestamps and generic request-failure categories are retained; no full health response.
No continuous uptime claim between minute samples; service-restart stability is separately checked with host snapshots. The observation does not assert health.app; the host check does.

hostStability.runner: self-hosted linux x64 nxttrack, matrix staging/production serialized max-parallel1, fail-fast=false, timeout5min per job
require: Run once after deployment and before observation; again after completed observation. Both target snapshots in both runs must exist and status=passed.
Each snapshot target/SHA match; health=passed and immutableIdentity=passed-and-unchanged.
Current realpath is a direct release child; exact-source artifact has schemaVersion1, correct purpose, repository=nxttrack/platform and final SHA; identity bytes/path are unchanged across snapshot.
Public health is HTTP200, app=nxttrack-platform, ok=true, correct env/SHA, database/schema pass; redirects rejected.
Fixed services nxttrack-{target} and caddy: ActiveState=active, SubState=running, MainPID>0.

For each target/service, compare snapshots at least1800000ms apart using observedAt: MainPID, NRestarts and ActiveEnterTimestamp must all remain identical. NRestarts alone does not rule out manual restart.
privacyAndLimits: Only five allowlisted systemctl properties via execFileSync, command timeout5s and output cap8192 bytes; no shell/journal/environment/config dump.
Health limit64KiB and15s timeout; generic failures; output flagwx mode0600. No DB credentials or remote writes.
Script validates one snapshot; the >=30min interval and cross-snapshot equality must be checked externally. Snapshot does not replace continuous minute health evidence.

finalEvidenceBoundaries: A successful selected workflow alone does not prove all required final conditions: inspect per-target JSON and screenshots plus full observation and host comparison.
Manual monitor proof is separately mode=probe + RUN_OPERATIONAL_PROBE; never drill for this task; require actual heartbeat PASS, not only workflow success.
Canonical runtime-readiness is separate: require both ready=true AND explicit final SHA and operationsMode=versioned, fresh workers and complete backups.
No source mutation, workflow dispatch, authenticated request or test suite was executed during this review.
